easy.q: ___ it was cold, she didn't wear a coat.
easy.explain: Hai vế trái ngược, sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'it was cold' → Although.

easy.q: The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.
easy.explain: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'the storm' → because of.

easy.q: He was hungry, ___ he made a sandwich.
easy.explain: Vế sau là kết quả của vế trước → so.

easy.q: She is saving money ___ buy a new phone.
easy.explain: Chỉ mục đích, sau chỗ trống là động từ nguyên mẫu 'buy' → in order to.

easy.q: The soup was ___ hot that I couldn't eat it.
easy.explain: so + tính từ + that → so hot that.

easy.q: They are ___ friendly people that everyone likes them.
easy.explain: such + (adj) + danh từ số nhiều 'people' + that → such (không có 'a').

easy.q: ___ the traffic jam, we arrived on time.
easy.explain: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'the traffic jam', ý tương phản → In spite of.

easy.q: I stayed at home yesterday ___ I was ill.
easy.explain: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'I was ill', chỉ lý do → because.

easy.q: The hotel was cheap. ___, it was close to the beach.
easy.explain: Hai ý đều là ưu điểm → bổ sung thông tin → Moreover.
Phòng khi điều gì xảy ra → in case.

normal.q: ___ the fact that he was injured, he finished the race.
normal.explain: Sau chỗ trống là 'the fact that…' (cụm danh từ) → Despite; 'Although' phải đi trực tiếp với mệnh đề.

normal.q: She speaks quietly ___ she won't wake the baby.
normal.explain: Chỉ mục đích, sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề 'she won't wake' → so that; 'in order to' phải đi với V nguyên mẫu.

normal.q: It rained heavily all morning; ___, the football match was postponed.
normal.explain: Vế sau là kết quả, có dấu chấm phẩy trước và dấu phẩy sau → trạng từ liên kết therefore; 'however' chỉ tương phản.

normal.q: ___ his lack of experience, he got the job.
normal.explain: Cụm danh từ 'his lack of experience' + ý tương phản → In spite of; 'In spite' thiếu 'of'.

normal.q: My brother loves action films, ___ I prefer comedies.
normal.explain: So sánh hai sự việc đối lập → whereas; 'despite' không đi với mệnh đề.

normal.q: Neither my parents nor my sister ___ coffee.
normal.explain: neither A nor B → động từ chia theo B 'my sister' (số ít) → likes.

normal.q: The test was ___ difficult for most students to finish on time.
normal.explain: too + adj + for sb + to V → quá … đến nỗi không thể; 'so' cần đi với 'that'.

normal.q: He left home early ___ miss the train.
normal.explain: Mục đích phủ định → in order not to + V; 'so that' phải đi với mệnh đề (so that he wouldn't miss).

normal.q: We couldn't go out ___ the heavy snow.
normal.explain: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ 'the heavy snow' → due to; 'because' và 'since' cần mệnh đề.

normal.q: ___ he is very rich, he lives in a small house.
normal.explain: Tương phản, sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề → Even though; 'Despite' không đi với mệnh đề, 'However' không nối mệnh đề phụ.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: Although she was (A) exhausted, (B) but she (C) kept working (D) until midnight.
hard.explain: Although và but không dùng cùng lúc trong một câu → bỏ 'but' (Although she was exhausted, she kept working…).

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Despite of the bad weather, the concert (B) went ahead (C) as (D) planned.
hard.explain: 'Despite' không có 'of' → Despite the bad weather (hoặc In spite of).

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: Although the room was small, it was comfortable.

options.A: Despite small room, it was comfortable.
options.B: Despite its small size, the room was comfortable.
options.C: In spite of the room was small, it was comfortable.
options.D: Because of the room was small, it was comfortable.

hard.explain: Although + mệnh đề ↔ Despite + cụm danh từ 'its small size'; 'In spite of' không đi với mệnh đề.

options.A: However it was late, we continued working.
options.B: It was late, however we continued working.
options.C: It was late. However, we continued working.
options.D: It was late, however, we continued working.

hard.explain: However là trạng từ liên kết: đứng đầu câu mới (hoặc sau dấu chấm phẩy) và có dấu phẩy sau; không nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.

options.A: It was so a heavy box that I couldn't lift it.
options.B: The box was too heavy for me to lift it.
options.C: The box wasn't heavy enough for me to lift.
options.D: It was such a heavy box that I couldn't lift it.

hard.explain: such + a + adj + N + that giữ nguyên nghĩa; 'too heavy for me to lift it' thừa 'it' vì chủ ngữ đã là 'the box'.

hard.q: Not only ___ the exam, but she also got the highest score in her class.
hard.explain: Not only đứng đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ: did she pass.

hard.q: He studied very hard; ___, he didn't pass the final exam.
hard.explain: Hai vế trái ngược (học chăm nhưng vẫn trượt) → nevertheless; 'therefore / as a result' chỉ kết quả nên sai nghĩa.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: He was ill. He still went to work.

options.A: Despite he was ill, he went to work.
options.B: In spite of being ill, he went to work.
options.C: He was ill, so he went to work.
options.D: Because of being ill, he went to work.

hard.explain: Ý tương phản → In spite of + V-ing; 'Despite he was ill' sai vì despite không đi với mệnh đề.

hard.q: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.
hard.explain: Điều kiện 'miễn là' → as long as; 'unless' (trừ khi) làm ngược nghĩa.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: The match was cancelled because it rained heavily.

options.A: The match was cancelled because the heavy rain.
options.B: The match was cancelled because of it rained heavily.
options.C: The match was cancelled due to it rained heavily.
options.D: The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain.

hard.explain: because + mệnh đề ↔ because of + cụm danh từ 'the heavy rain'; 'due to / because of' không đi với mệnh đề.
